She only spawns at night (9 PM - 9 AM). 

Her placeholder spawn in the daytime is a scaled wolf pup, roaming the same path she does. 

She is a Paladin who uses Courage, Gather Shadows (invisibility), Healing (which heals about 4-5% of her HP), and Laying of Hands. Also casts Root.

She can duo-attack for roughly 70 damage max and is a bit slower than the average mob. 

The moment she is killed, she immediately respawns elsewhere on the beach. If it is nighttime and the pup is up and killed, Jairnel will spawn. If it is daytime and Jairnel is up and killed, the pup will spawn.
